steps: Toast region aria-live=polite, undo CTA focusable

undo-toast.notes: Canon for the undo-toast durations (SKILL.md cites this file). ≥ 6s is the single-item floor. Bulk-destructive gets 12–30s, not a vague 'extended': a bulk mistake is noticed while scanning the result set, not at click time — the window must survive that scan plus touch/screen-reader latency, and a wrong bulk action is exactly where undo is worth the longer toast.

steps: Render persistent countdown banner until window elapses
recall-window.copySlot: inline-error-banner (with neutral tone) or custom recall slot

steps: Body names reversibility + who else is affected
Destructive CTA uses danger tokens + non-color cue
Emit audit event visible in user-facing audit log
Render destructive-confirmation dialog with name-echo input
User types resource name exactly; destructive CTA disabled until exact match
On submit, re-auth (password / WebAuthn / SSO re-prompt) within 15-minute window
Initiator proposes action via type-to-confirm + re-auth
Approval request routed to a second eligible approver (not the initiator)
Action executes; audit event records both actors

common.enter: Does not submit unless destructive CTA is explicitly focused.
common.styling: Destructive CTA uses semantic danger tokens + a non-color cue (weight, icon, or fill treatment).
